solar_panel.name: Solar Panel
solar_panel.description: Generates passive sol energy recharge for your Sol Unit. +1 energy per panel every 10 seconds while on the dayside.

salvage_harvester.name: Salvage Harvester
salvage_harvester.description: Automated drone that collects salvage from defeated Nightside creatures. Produces 1 salvage every 60 seconds.

silicon_refinery.name: Silicon Refinery
silicon_refinery.description: Refines raw salvage into silicon — the advanced resource needed for high-tier automation structures. Produces 1 silicon every 45 seconds. Doubles the output of adjacent Salvage Harvesters.

auto_turret.name: Auto-Turret
auto_turret.description: Automated defense turret that protects nearby structures during raid events. +50 defense rating per turret.

fabricator.name: Fabricator
fabricator.description: Advanced automated production unit. High-efficiency salvage collection yields 1 salvage every 30 seconds.

expedition_beacon.name: Expedition Beacon
expedition_beacon.description: Long-range signal beacon that reduces expedition silicon costs by 50%. Only one can be active.

bio_harvester.name: Bio-Harvester
bio_harvester.description: Underlumen growth repurposed as automated salvage collection. Places a free copy every 30 minutes, up to 5 total. First placement is also free.

symbiotic_node.name: Symbiotic Node
symbiotic_node.description: A merged tech-organic structure that functions as both a solar panel and salvage harvester at 75% efficiency each.

array_drone_bay.name: Array Drone Bay
array_drone_bay.description: Reprogrammed Array drones automatically repair damaged structures after raid events. Each bay repairs 1 structure per hour.

_milestoneRewards.description: Grid modifier: +20% damage to adjacent abilities

_milestoneRewards.name: Efficiency Core

_milestoneRewards.name: Basic Generator
_milestoneRewards.description: Passive energy regen — the beginning of true independence

_milestoneRewards.name: Area Expander

_milestoneRewards.name: Improved Generator
_milestoneRewards.description: Upgraded passive energy regen — 4 energy per second

_milestoneRewards.description: Defensive Sol ability — project an energy barrier
